video_title: Latest on Kawhi Leonard & Jokic + Free Agency Primer With Insider Marc Stein | ALL NBA Podcast

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic may not sign a contract extension with the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic does not plan to sign or may not be planning to sign an extension
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic does not plan to sign or may not be planning to sign an extension with the Denver Nuggets, which he is eligible to do starting, I believe, Sunday. He did not sign it last year. He has reiterated that exact phrasing not long ago, and yet now the latest rumor is he is not going to sign it this year. He is going to go to next summer, which means he could opt out of his player option.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic is considering delaying his contract extension with the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: Jokic is giving consideration to holding off on a contract extension this summer as well
quotes.quote: Jokic is giving consideration to holding off on a contract extension this summer as well. The caveat there is the Nuggets don't know for how long. It might not necessarily be until next summer. Once July 6th comes, Jokic can do an extension at any date between July 6th and next June 30th, and I am pretty sure your Nuggets will give him a Mont Blanc pen any day he wants to do it.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell is ineligible for a contract extension due to the timing of his last one
quotes.excerpt: Donovan Mitchell did his last extension on July 7th. And so because he's July 7th rather than July 6th
quotes.quote: Donovan Mitchell did his last extension on July 7th. And so because he's July 7th rather than July 6th, by the letter of the law, he and the Cavs are not allowed to talk about an extension.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic is applying pressure on the Nuggets by delaying his extension
quotes.excerpt: This is the first semblance of pressure that Jokic has ever applied on this organization

text_blocks.speaker: Marc Stein
text_blocks.text: This is the first semblance of pressure that Jokic has ever applied on this organization. And even if applying pressure is not his goal, even if he is really waiting for money reasons again, the effect is he is applying pressure to the Nuggets like never before.

text_blocks.speaker: Adam Mares
text_blocks.text: Some gladness, for sure. I mean, here's the situation. He can make slightly more money. It's a little convoluted because rather than working out an extension, he just can sign if the salary cap goes up by X amount. I think over the course of five years, basically in total earnings, he would earn an extra like 19 or 20 million, somewhere around there. It's not that much money.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Vultures in the league are monitoring Nikola Jokic's contract situation
quotes.excerpt: The vultures in the league and they're in 29 other front offices, when there's even a sliver of hope
quotes.quote: The vultures in the league and they're in 29 other front offices, when there's even a sliver of hope that a presumed unattainable guy is now attainable, there will be vultures. I mean, that's just the way it is. He's still right there in the conversation for best player in the world.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Nuggets have looked into Jaylen Brown as a potential trade target
quotes.excerpt: They have looked into Jaylen Brown. Now, do you, as the foremost Nuggets expert in my life, want to see
quotes.quote: They have looked into Jaylen Brown. Now, do you, as the foremost Nuggets expert in my life, want to see your team going after Jaylen Brown? And I heard tonight my guy Bill Simmons saying, Murray and Cam Johnson for Brown and Hyland, and we'll deal with the pick compensation later.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Nuggets are considering trading Jamal Murray, Aaron Gordon, Cam Johnson, or Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Everything is on the table except trading number 15. That means Murray, Gordon, Johnson, Brown
quotes.quote: Everything is on the table except trading number 15. That means Murray, Gordon, Johnson, Brown. I've reported multiple times Gordon is the one getting the most interest, but there's interest in Cam Johnson too. They'll be able to trade Cam Johnson if they want to.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Hornets were smart to trade LaMelo Ball for a full season of value
quotes.excerpt: Charlotte I think got a lot back for LaMelo Ball. And I think they were very smart
quotes.quote: Charlotte I think got a lot back for LaMelo Ball. And I think they were very smart. He played 72 games this season. The previous three seasons he missed, I don't even remember how many, I lost count. They were clearly like, we got a full season out of this guy. We kept his minutes down too. This is now Charles Lee's team and Brandon Miller's team and Charles Lee's team, so they decided I think very shortly after the season that they were going to go this direction.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball was second only to Nikola Jokic in shot quality creation
quotes.excerpt: Last season LaMelo Ball was second in the league only to Jokic in terms of shot quality
quotes.quote: Last season LaMelo Ball was second in the league only to Jokic in terms of shot quality created for his teammates. Like the pace he plays with, the passing eye he has, he makes the game easier for those guys in Charlotte. They're going to miss him.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers are more interested in Brandon Ingram than RJ Barrett
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers more interested in Brandon Ingram than RJ Barrett
quotes.quote: The Clippers more interested in Brandon Ingram than RJ Barrett.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Raptors are interested in a trade involving Brandon Ingram
quotes.excerpt: It's the Raptors who would want this to be with Ingram in the deal, not RJ Barrett
quotes.quote: It's the Raptors who would want this to be with Ingram in the deal, not RJ Barrett. We'll see. Look, the teams are talking. Jake Fischer reported this on Thursday for the first time that the Raptors are interested, but more amazingly, I think probably the louder line that Kawhi Leonard's preference is to stay with the Clippers.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers are unlikely to trade Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard's preference is to stay with the Clippers. And the Clippers would prefer to keep him
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard's preference is to stay with the Clippers. And the Clippers would prefer to keep him, but this is the last year of his deal and they got to come to an extension and it's not clear if they can come to an agreement on an extension.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers and Kawhi Leonard are struggling to agree on an extension
quotes.excerpt: The message has been transmitted that Kawhi is open to doing an extension if he were traded
quotes.quote: The message has been transmitted that Kawhi is open to doing an extension if he were traded to his two previous teams, Toronto and San Antonio. I don't know that we were expecting that when the NBA Finals ended and we started shifting into off-season mode. Based on our reporting, he would not be interested in an extension if he were traded to, say, Detroit or Miami, which are teams that would naturally be interested in Kawhi Leonard if they

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers traded Ivica Zubac to the Pacers for a package including draft picks
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers trade Zubac to the Pacers for this package that that was a really
quotes.quote: The Clippers trade Zubac to the Pacers for this package that that was a really, you want to talk about trades that rocked the league, that really shocked everyone, that the Clippers would trade Zubac at that point. Pacers put multiple good firsts in that deal because the Pacers were sure that if Zubac was kept until now, the bidding for him would be even higher for a center who's a borderline All-Star.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Timberwolves are interested in extending Tim Connelly
quotes.excerpt: I think the Wolves want to extend him. That was certainly the talk all spring
quotes.quote: I think the Wolves want to extend him. That was certainly the talk all spring that when Dallas was interested in Tim Connelly, that the Wolves were not even going to give that a chance.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Timberwolves are interested in extending Tim Connelly
quotes.excerpt: The Wolves want to extend him. That was certainly the talk all spring
quotes.quote: The Wolves want to extend him. That was certainly the talk all spring that when Dallas was interested in Tim Connelly, that the Wolves were not even going to give that a chance.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Nuggets are interested in hiring Dave Joerger as an assistant coach
quotes.excerpt: I confirmed tonight that Dave Joerger has interviewed for the post
quotes.quote: I confirmed tonight that Dave Joerger has interviewed for the post, but here's the thing, Dave Joerger is also being pursued very heavily by Paris Basketball, which is the team that is run by former Timberwolves front office lead decision maker David Kahn.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pistons are looking to upgrade their roster around Cade Cunningham
quotes.excerpt: They were known that they're going to be aggressive to try to improve Cade Cunningham's supporting cast
quotes.quote: They were known that they're going to be aggressive to try to improve Cade Cunningham's supporting cast. And so, Tyler Herro, Norman Powell, Isaiah Joe, these were some of the names we heard because, look, I think Kyrie Irving and Trey Murphy were really at the top of their list, but the Mavericks have been telling teams that Kyrie Irving's not available and the price for Trey Murphy, you know, the word is you need you need to put three first-round picks on the table to try to get him away from the Pelicans.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pistons are prioritizing re-signing Ausar Thompson and extending Isaiah Stewart
quotes.excerpt: The priorities for the Pistons this summer is to resign Ausar Thompson and to do an extension
quotes.quote: The priorities for the Pistons this summer is to resign Ausar Thompson and to do an extension with a Sarr Thompson. And we haven't even talked about restricted free agency that there are some really good restricted free agents. Durren, your guy Peyton Watson, Walker Kessler, who of course we know the Lakers would love to try to acquire if possible.
